description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education - Degree Awarding Institute orders
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the recognition of a private institution (Esoft Metro Campus) as a degree-awarding institute under the Universities Act. It constitutes a regulatory order issued by the Minister, making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel or structural matter. The content focuses on establishing regulatory conditions and frameworks for higher education operations, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
